items.definition:
an animal, especially a large or dangerous one
The beast emerged from the forest.

a special event for enjoyment
The town held a big celebration for its anniversary.

an official document
He received a certificate for completing the course.

a type of heavy, sticky earth
The artist molded the clay into a beautiful pot.

a person with whom one works
I discussed the issue with my colleague.

a person who supports or admires someone
She has many followers on social media.

a silly or stupid person
Don't be a fool; think before you act.

an aircraft powered by jet engines
The jet flew high above the clouds.

the way in which a person or group lives
A healthy lifestyle includes exercise and good food.

the arrangement or effect of lights
The lighting in the room was very dim.

story
The old man told a fascinating tale about his travels.

a person who offers to do something without being forced or paid
Many volunteers helped clean up the park.

a warning sound or signal; fear or anxiety
The fire alarm rang loudly.

a device that removes impurities or unwanted elements
The coffee machine has a built-in filter.

the Earth; a spherical model of the Earth
The children learned about different countries on the globe.

a symbol or other design adopted by an organization to identify its products, uniform, vehicles, etc.
The company updated its logo last year.

the process of producing books, newspapers, etc., by machine
The printing of the new book will begin next week.

a device used to force liquid or gas into or out of something
We need a pump to inflate the tires.

a small piece of paper; a mistake
I made a slip of the tongue during the presentation.

a person who has special knowledge or skill in a particular area
You should see a specialist about your knee pain.

the business of providing services for tourists
Tourism is a major industry in this region.

a reddish-brown metal
The pipes were made of copper.

the first appearance of light in the sky before sunrise
We woke up at dawn to see the sunrise.

money obtained in return for labor or services
His earning potential increased after he got his degree.

a dramatic work in one or more acts, set to music
They went to see an opera at the Royal Opera House.

a narrow way allowing access; a section of text
The secret passage led to an old hidden room.

a large hole in the ground; a stone of a fruit
They dug a deep pit to plant the new tree.

a melody or song
I can't get that catchy tune out of my head.

a wild plant growing where it is not wanted
I spent the afternoon pulling weeds from the garden.

Japanese animated films and television shows
Many people enjoy watching Japanese anime series.

a device for holding things together; a short extract from a film or broadcast
She used a paper clip to hold the documents together.

a formal test or inspection
The doctor performed a thorough examination.

sudden uncontrollable fear or anxiety
There was a moment of panic when the lights went out.

plan; order
We need to make an arrangement for the meeting next week.

a sovereign ruler of great power and rank
The emperor ruled over a vast empire.

a meeting or assembly
There was a small gathering of friends at her house.

an official who examines things carefully
The building inspector checked the new construction.

a colorless, odorless reactive gas
Humans need oxygen to breathe.

a piece of writing in which the expression of feelings and ideas is given intensity by the use of distinctive style and rhythm
She wrote a beautiful poem about nature.

a metal fastener with a helical thread
He used a screwdriver to tighten the screw.

a place providing protection from bad weather or danger
They sought shelter from the storm.

signature
Please put your signature at the bottom of the form.

deposit
You need to pay a deposit to rent the apartment.

destination
We reached our destination after a long journey.

habit
It's a good habit to read every day.

a light tap or stroke
She gave the dog a gentle pat on the head.

the state of being liked by many people
The singer's popularity grew rapidly.

a person who secretly gathers information
The spy collected secret documents.

an idea or plan put forward
Do you have any suggestions for dinner?

an underground passage
The train went through a long tunnel.

artificial intelligence
AI is changing many industries.

a person not in the armed forces

training to obey rules
Good discipline is essential for success.

a short piece of writing on a particular subject
I have to write an essay for my English class.

a person or thing that makes something
He is a skilled furniture maker.

someone who competes against or fights another
He defeated his opponent in the final round.

a long, slender piece of wood or metal
The flag was flying from the top of the pole.

a keeper of a park or forest
The park ranger warned us about bears.

the area in a hotel or office where guests are greeted
Please ask at the reception desk for your key.

elastic material
The sole of the shoe is made of rubber.

small building
We keep our gardening tools in the shed.

the study of living organisms
She is studying biology at university.

artificial waterway
The Panama Canal connects the Atlantic and Pacific oceans.

a sea voyage for pleasure
They went on a cruise to the Caribbean.
